method: same actual owner payloads, warmed caches, alternating AB/BA across 6 rounds, 12 reads per sample, GC only before timed sample; no verifier work timed
limits: Node-only cache warm-hit microbenchmark; no browser, IndexedDB duration, end-to-end, p95 or acceptance claim
Actual NativeRepository and WorkspaceRepository inputs generated in MockIDB; no real account/profile data
Capturing/freezing/checksum/schema verifier cost excluded from timed warm hits
The earlier concurrent full-Node benchmark is retained but invalid for performance decisions
medianDefinition: Arithmetic mean of the third and fourth ordered per-read sample values in six rounds

semanticTests.note: Per-candidate semantic cases are not additive coverage; no test-only patch integrated.

inputProvenance: Real NativeRepository and WorkspaceRepository over MOCK_IDB, 200 batches of 50 refs; 10000 PROJECT members at revision201. Captured 1000/5000/10000-member roots.
